name: Benchmarking Neural Topic Models
description: Provides an empirical comparison of neural topic modeling methods across datasets and metrics to standardize evaluation and highlight practical performance differences.
evaluation_method: topic coherence (NPMI/UMass) and perplexity (with downstream classification accuracy sometimes reported)
reputation: Well-regarded within the neural topic modeling subcommunity as an empirical standardization effort, though niche compared to mainstream supervised NLP benchmarks.
notes: Unsupervised task — evaluation metrics (e.g., coherence) can disagree with human judgments; dataset and preprocessing choices strongly affect results; not aimed at LLM-specific evaluation.
